mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing policy that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase corporate earnings uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based consumer demand contraction, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In regimes where industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturing output contraction signals a deepening economic slowdown and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) relative to the previous quarter signals a recessionary demand shock, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate further economic deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 declines quarter-over-quarter, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a severe labor market deterioration, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate hiring freezes and reduced consumer spending dampen equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In regimes of declining housing starts (HOUST < 1400 thousand units), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to the housing sector's role as a leading indicator of consumer spending and economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST < 1400, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
